info.title: arcaeon serve
info.description: The local HTTP/JSON API of arcaeon: one route per check, each answering the CLI's --json plus an integer exit (0 good, 1 a bad finding, 2 bad usage, 3 COULD NOT LOOK). Loopback only.

200.description: ok

400.description: bad usage: not JSON, a field the schema refuses, a path outside the served root

404.description: no such route, or declared but not built in this checkout
